snippet.title: SKATEBOUND (2026) Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the 2.5D world of skateboarding like never seen before - SKATEBOUND is an RPG coming to Steam this summer, inspired by the stories of every skateboarder's journey.
